description:
• About our brand and products:

Jaca represents a breakthrough in the sugar industry.  As a rare sugar, Jaca® offers a unique combination of health benefits and sensory satisfaction that sets it apart from both traditional sugar and existing alternatives.

At its core, Jaca® is a monosaccharide – an actual sugar, not an alternative sweetener - which means it tastes, cooks, and bakes like traditional sugar.  Unlike sucrose, Jaca® comes with an impressive array of health benefits and certifications that make it suitable for a variety of dietary needs and preferences.

Jaca® is:

  • Non-GMO and Vegan friendly, catering to the growing demand for natural products
  • Zero Glycemic Index registered, making it keto friendly and safe for diabetics and those monitoring their blood sugar levels
  • Proposition 65 Compliant in California, ensuring it meets strict safety standards
  • FDA GRAS (Generally Recognized as Safe), validating its safety for consumption
  • National Sanitation Foundation Certified, meeting rigorous public health and safety standards
  • FODMAP friendly, meaning it doesn't cause gastric distress, unlike many other sweeteners
  • Unique in that it does not need to be recorded as “sugar” on Nutrition Labels

Jaca also has clinically proven health benefits.  Studies have shown that Jaca can decrease body fat, control appetite, and inhibit the body's ability to assimilate new fat.  These properties take it beyond a simple sugar alternative and make it a tool in combating obesity and related health issues.


• What makes us different:

Jaca stands at the forefront of a nutritional revolution, poised to transform the sweetener industry with its groundbreaking ingredient. 

A sweetener with no aftertaste that cooks and bakes like the sugar we grew up with where there is no weight gain, sugar high, sugar crash or other health risks, Jaca truly is paradigm shifting.  Diabetic & Keto friendly, Non GMO, the list of benefits goes on and on.

Jaca will dethrone traditional sucrose as the apex sugar, freeing people to make the healthy choice, enjoying the delicious sweetness and texture they love without having to settle. 

This is the sugar that we should’ve had all along…


• Other information:

Partnership With Howie Mandel.  Affectionately known as "America's Dad" for his warm, relatable humor and unfiltered family anecdotes, Howie Mandel has built an illustrious career that spans decades of entertaining audiences with his signature blend of comedy and vulnerability. As a Canadian-born comedian who rose to fame in the 1980s through his role on St. Elsewhere, Mandel quickly became a household name, showcasing his ability to mix slapstick antics with heartfelt drama.  He hosted the game show Deal or No Deal from 2005 to 2017, turning briefcases into moments of genuine human connection.  Today, as a beloved judge on America's Got Talent, he continues to champion underdogs with his quick wit and infectious enthusiasm, while his podcast Howie Mandel Does Stuff - co-hosted with his daughter Jackelyn -offers fans a peek into his life as a devoted family man. 

 

Existing and New SKU’s. 

Existing:

While Jaca® rare sugar forms the cornerstone of HFLF's product line, the company is actively engaged in developing a diverse range of Jaca® powered products to cater to various market segments and consumer preferences.



Jaca Jolt.  A healthy energy boost, the Jolt is a 2 oz bottle drink that has a shot of caffeine (without overdoing it) and vitamins B6 & B12, so you can Power Your Hour and stay energized (Jaca Jolt).  No harmful or corrosive additives, the Jaca Jolt provides natural energy and staves off the jitters and crashes.

 

New:

The Skinny Jacarita™.   The “Skinny” market, much like everything else in the F&B space, is false propaganda.  Skinny Margaritas still have Triple Sec and Agave, and (sometimes) juice or other sweeteners which contain conventional  sugar or sugar alternatives (that are proving to be more dangerous for consumption than traditional sugar itself). 

HFLF has created a truly Diabetic Friendly Jacarita that tastes amazing.  Currently, this drink is being served in multiple restaurants at The Hub in Allen, TX. The Hub is the #1 seller of alcohol in this part of Dallas (DFW area) which includes a Top Golf.

HFLF is also working on an RTD (Ready To Drink) bottle for retail sale.  The alcoholic beverage portion of the $3 trillion Consumer Product Goods space could prove to be highly relevant from a market penetration standpoint.


Jaca Powered Sweet Tea.   Building on the success of the Skinny Jacarita, HFLF has developed a healthier version of sweet tea. This product has been well-received at The Hub and at local conferences, with participants enthusiastically taking home half-gallons of the drink to their friends and families. Tasting like Snapple with none of the health detriments, people were drinking 7 and 8 cups of Jaca Tea with no sugar high, no sugar crash, no weight gain.
